 report['skill_status']=meta.get('status')
 report['executor_path']=meta.get('executor')

 assert meta.get('status')=='completed' and str(meta.get('executor','')).startswith(str(root/'.runtime/npm/rea/')) and report['real_rea_tools_list']
 report['post_services']=states()

 report['status']='PASS_ACTIVE_NEW_RELEASE'
except Exception as exc:

  report['rollback_executed']=rollback_ok
 report['post_services']=states()
